name: Baron Revilgaz
summary: On Booty Bay’s high balcony, Baron Revilgaz holds the port and its trade in his hands. He leads the Blackwater Raiders for the Steamwheedle Cartel, keeping the harbor open to Alliance and Horde while guarding his own interests. He hires help to watch rivals and seek ancient relics in the jungle.

sections.title: Master of Booty Bay
sections.body:
From the Salty Sailor Tavern, Baron Revilgaz watches Booty Bay’s docks with Fleet Master Seahorn, his trusted tauren advisor, beside him. Cutpurses, merchants, and privateers all answer to his firm hand. Blackwater Cove began as a human settlement, but trolls overwhelmed it before the First War. Goblins claimed and fortified the port, and it grew into the Blackwater Raiders’ commercial hub.

Revilgaz keeps Booty Bay officially open to Alliance and Horde travelers. He enforces neutrality within the harbor so trade can continue.

sections.title: A Web of Ambition
sections.body:
When wars elsewhere in Azeroth slowed business, Revilgaz found a way to draw crowds back to Booty Bay. The discovery of tastyfish gave him the means: he created the Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza. Across Stranglethorn Vale, he keeps watch on rivals and threats.

He hires sabotage against the Venture Company at Lake Nazferiti. He also watches Nesingwary’s hunting expedition and rogue human military camps in the north. With Monte Gazlowe and Pozzik at the Mirage Raceway, he keeps trade ties active.

sections.title: The Stone of the Tides
sections.body:
Beyond the harbor, Revilgaz pursues wealth and ancient power. Rumors tell of a haunted island off the coast, and he sends adventurers to seek the legendary Stone of the Tides. They consult ancient tomes in the Stormwind Library and study elemental residues with Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver. Then they recover an ancient troll dagger from the Bloodsail Buccaneers.

The dagger breaks the coastal altar’s protection. Revilgaz breaks a deadly elemental curse and claims the priceless relic for his vaults.

faq.answer: Baron Revilgaz leads Booty Bay and the Blackwater Raiders for the Steamwheedle Cartel. Greed and practical diplomacy guide his rule of the pirate port.

faq.q: Where can Baron Revilgaz be found?
faq.answer: Baron Revilgaz keeps to the top balcony of the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay. Fleet Master Seahorn, his trusted advisor, stands with him as he looks over the cove.

faq.q: What is Revilgaz's relationship with the Bloodsail Buccaneers?
faq.answer: The Bloodsail Buccaneers are bitter enemies of Revilgaz. They reject the Steamwheedle Cartel’s rules and raid Booty Bay shipping. Their leaders plot to kill Revilgaz and Seahorn.

faq.q: What is Revilgaz's stake in the Mirage Raceway?
faq.answer: Revilgaz backs Pozzik’s goblin racing team against the gnomes in the Shimmering Flats. He sends adventurers to steal the Venture Company’s proprietary fuel regulator blueprints at Lake Nazferiti and bring them to the raceway.

faq.q: What is the Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza?
faq.answer: The Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza is a weekly fishing contest along the Stranglethorn coast. When wars elsewhere in Azeroth slowed trade, Revilgaz backed angler Riggle Bassbait and made the local tastyfish catch a tournament to revive Booty Bay’s economy.

faq.q: What is the Stone of the Tides?
faq.answer: The Stone of the Tides is an ancient cursed stone hidden at the Vile Reef. Revilgaz learns its legend from Stormwind records and hires Dalaran scholar Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver to help adventurers break its elemental wards and claim it.

angles.text: As a rogue, you may find that Revilgaz values thieves, spies, and opportunists. He hires rogues for risky theft, sabotage against rival cartels, and secret retrieval of rare jungle artifacts.

As an Alliance traveler, you can trace Booty Bay to the ruins of Blackwater Cove, a Stormwind enclave from before the First War. Revilgaz works with human scholars and librarians in Stormwind when ancient lore may bring profit.
As an engineer, you’ll find Revilgaz caught up in goblin engineering rivalries. He uses underhanded means to obtain advanced blueprints and fuel regulators from the Venture Company.
